_source: Minimal personal-brand profile: the smallest brand.json the engine accepts. It renders ONLY the brand-message template, so it declares no event-category taxonomy, no month names and no list-format copy — data a typography-led carousel never reads. Its existence is the regression test for that: if loadBrand ever goes back to validating the whole schema unconditionally, `render-brand.ts --profile example-personal` stops working.
